0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, on a two-game losing streak and 13th in the East) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home, on a three-game losing streak and 12th in the West) for the Nets' 11th game of the season. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr., who is out with illness and averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game, and Nolan Traore, who is out with calf soreness, while New Orleans is missing Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their most recent meeting was a 116-113 Nets loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026, with no games between them yet in 2026-27.
